mapper.select: SELECT U.USER_ID, U.COMPANY_ID, U.SITE_ID, U.DEPT_ID, U.LANG_CODE FROM TB_USER U JOIN TB_COMPANY C ON C.COMPANY_ID = U.COMPANY_ID AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN TB_SITE S ON S.SITE_ID = U.SITE_ID LEFT JOIN TB_DEPT D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId} AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.USER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND (U.SITE_ID IS NULL OR S.USE_YN = 'Y') AND (U.DEPT_ID IS NULL OR D.USE_YN = 'Y')

SELECT A.MENU_ID, A.ACCESS_LEVEL, A.DATA_SCOPE FROM TB_ROLE_MENU_AUTH A JOIN TB_ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = A.ROLE_ID AND R.USE_YN = 'Y'
JOIN TB_MENU M ON M.MENU_ID = A.MENU_ID AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT A.MENU_ID, A.ACCESS_LEVEL, A.DATA_SCOPE FROM TB_USER_MENU_AUTH A JOIN TB_MENU M ON M.MENU_ID = A.MENU_ID AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.VALID_FROM <= SYSDATE AND (A.VALID_TO IS NULL OR A.VALID_TO >= SYSDATE)

SELECT DISTINCT A.MENU_ID, A.BUTTON_ID, A.ACCESS_YN FROM TB_ROLE_BUTTON_AUTH A JOIN TB_ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = A.ROLE_ID AND R.USE_YN = 'Y'
JOIN TB_MENU_BUTTON MB ON MB.MENU_ID = A.MENU_ID AND MB.BUTTON_ID = A.BUTTON_ID AND MB.USE_YN = 'Y' JOIN TB_MENU M ON M.MENU_ID = A.MENU_ID AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' JOIN TB_BUTTON B ON B.BUTTON_ID = A.BUTTON_ID AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT A.MENU_ID, A.BUTTON_ID, A.ACCESS_YN FROM TB_USER_BUTTON_AUTH A JOIN TB_MENU_BUTTON MB ON MB.MENU_ID = A.MENU_ID AND MB.BUTTON_ID = A.BUTTON_ID AND MB.USE_YN = 'Y' JOIN TB_MENU M ON M.MENU_ID = A.MENU_ID AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' JOIN TB_BUTTON B ON B.BUTTON_ID = A.BUTTON_ID AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.VALID_FROM <= SYSDATE AND (A.VALID_TO IS NULL OR A.VALID_TO >= SYSDATE)
SELECT MENU_ID FROM TB_MENU WHERE MENU_CODE = #{menuCode} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT B.BUTTON_ID FROM TB_BUTTON B JOIN TB_MENU_BUTTON MB ON MB.BUTTON_ID = B.BUTTON_ID WHERE MB.MENU_ID = #{menuId} AND B.BUTTON_CODE = #{buttonCode} AND MB.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y'
